description: Document the EWS backend+frontend and perform the full local end-to-end verification + cleanup. Writes backend/README.md with setup/run/test instructions, a prominent anti-conflict warning, and an explicit TAHAP 2 scope note; then runs the whole test suite, a controlled background uvicorn start/stop, the broker-free pipeline injection demo, and cleans up temp DB files. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being complete.
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json (c:/aws-kiro/EWS_YG2UFH/.agents/tasks/task-ews-tahap1/context.json) and this file, plus FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 findings.

Write backend/README.md: setup (python -m venv backend/.venv; pip install -r requirements.txt; copy .env.example to .env); run (uvicorn app.main:app --port 8001); local testing WITHOUT external hardware/broker — either a local mosquitto + tools/simulate_node.py, OR broker-free tools/inject_sample.py; how to run tests (pytest tests/); the REST API list from technical-design.md §12.6; and a PROMINENT ANTI-CONFLICT section: EWS must use port 8001 / client_id ews-web-backend / topic yg2ufh/ews / db ews.db, and must NEVER connect to the production broker yg2ufh.mooo.com in automated tests because APRS on :8000 is live. Include an explicit note: real PDF export, real auth/login/chat, and alarm-sound editing are TAHAP 2 and are intentionally NOT implemented here.
Run the full suite from backend/: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/ -v` and confirm all pass.

Run a controlled start/stop on PowerShell: set env MQTT_BROKER_HOST=127.0.0.1 and MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX=yg2ufh/ews, start uvicorn on :8001 in the BACKGROUND (never a blocking foreground server), wait ~3s, confirm GET / , /node.html , /api/nodes return 200, then stop the process.
Run the broker-free demo `.venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/inject_sample.py` and confirm it injects readings and exits 0.
Clean up: delete any temp/test DB files produced during verification (stray data/*.db*) that are not meant to be committed; confirm no uvicorn process is left running.

Set this FEAT's status to completed in FEAT-003.json and record in findings the final verification results (pytest summary line, the three HTTP 200s, inject_sample result). Commit locally on the branch; never push.
acceptance_criteria: backend/README.md exists and states all four anti-conflict resources (port 8001, client_id ews-web-backend, topic yg2ufh/ews, db ews.db), the 'no production broker in automated tests' rule, and the TAHAP 2 exclusions (PDF export, auth/login/chat, alarm-sound editing).
A background uvicorn on :8001 serves GET / (200, contains 'YG2UFH'), /node.html (200), /api/nodes (200), and is then stopped cleanly.
`tools/inject_sample.py` runs with no broker and exits 0.
No stray committed DB file remains and no uvicorn process is left running after verification.
verification: From backend/: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/ -v` — all pass.
From backend/ (env set): background uvicorn :8001, then Invoke-WebRequest / , /node.html , /api/nodes all 200; stop the process.
Confirm `Test-Path backend/data/ews.db` reflects cleanup (no stray committed DB) and no uvicorn process remains.

findings.summary: FEAT-003 completed. backend/README.md documents setup (venv + pip install + copy .env.example), run (uvicorn app.main:app --port 8001), broker-free/local testing (tools/inject_sample.py or local mosquitto + tools/simulate_node.py), and how to run pytest. It carries a prominent ANTI-CONFLICT section stating all four EWS resources (port 8001, client_id ews-web-backend, topic yg2ufh/ews, db ews.db) and the rule that automated tests must NEVER connect to the production broker yg2ufh.mooo.com (APRS is live on :8000). It lists the §12.6 REST API and an explicit TAHAP 2 scope note: real PDF export, real auth/login/chat, and alarm-sound editing are intentionally NOT built here. Full local end-to-end verification run and passed; temp DB files cleaned; no uvicorn left running.
